hypothesis: After one synchronous child completes successfully in a one-shot parent whose existing delegation budget is one, removing delegate_task from that parent's model-visible tools prevents redundant post-success delegation while preserving the child result and final answer.
retry_policy: one scheduled attempt per frozen case; zero reruns after any observed result
interpretation_boundary: A 3/3 pass demonstrates only that this bounded runtime intervention repaired the observed post-success duplicate-delegation failure on these three frozen cases while the external enforcement remained active. It does not establish general Hermes reliability, model superiority, broader delegation quality, or readiness for unrestricted autonomy.

implementation.intervention: For a one-shot parent with oneshot_max_children=1, retire delegate_task from parent_agent.tools and parent_agent.valid_tool_names only after one synchronous child result has status completed and no schema failure; return the raw child result unchanged.

study.allowed_parent_action: one delegate_task spawn containing exactly one child; no parent evidence-tool work
study.acceptance: Exactly one attempted valid delegation and one successful child; zero extra delegation, parent evidence work, or enforcement intervention; first parent request includes delegate_task; sole follow-up parent request excludes delegate_task; process exit zero; exact final marker.
